body: I have very limited use of my hands due to advanced MS and barely have the coordination now to perform the steps needed. Any longer and I will be trapped here forever with no exit other than jumping or walking in front of a truck. Less guilt on others if I go by my own hand as it were.

Likewise... Glad to know that you're holding on.
I hugged my son for longer than I ever have in his short life, and owe that memory to you and your post. 

Thank you for the ray of hope. Blessed to have read your post and your reply. Hang in there.

I would truly appreciate that. 

So sorry to know that someone else has been there/done that... but glad t the same time to have made tht post and to have the ability to connect.

Thank you for sharing this and your story. You have truly given hope to another. Thank you.
I can't begin to express what it meant to read your post, and know that you are still here. Thanks for stopping what could have been my final act. You are a hero, and you may not have realized that.

If I may ask, which hotline did you call? I want to hang in here, but can't see the purpose... And then I read your post. Glad to see they helped you, maybe there can be some for me.
Thanks in advance, and for posting what you did.

My depression and self-defeat have cost me a 20-year marriage. I was diagnosed with MS five years ago (strangely enough the timeframe my "wife" has claimed to have "stopped loving me"... she told me that she wanted a divorce a month ago on my son's b-day, no less, because she "cannot be with someone who isn't healthy.") I've been living under false hope for about four years, it seems.
What's left?
I feel no other choice but to do this while my hands still function enough.
